objective: Exact native creation maps of every alternative placement the generator gives for TRISUM-READ's 17 glues (hash seeds 0 to 23); for each pair in one switching class, test whether the whole native maps are isomorphic (with the glue's lines fixed, and under any bijection) and whether the block of glue lines is identical; locate the differences.
status: Proved by exact computation: the generator gives 11 of TRISUM-READ's 17 glues 2 or 3 placements in one switching class (25 in all); in the 5 pairs mapped (38 to 56 points) the glue block of the native map is identical, the whole maps are never isomorphic (atom removals read the placement), and TRISUM-READ's P1 to P7 hold on all 5 alternative placements
title: Placements in one switching class
